name: Paradis printanier
description: Spring is a season for adventure, but you may fall into an unexpected wonderland before even realizing it! [https://act.hoyolab.com/ys/event/hoyofair202304-wds1p6/index.html >>>HoYoFair Spring 2023: Genshin Impact Fan Art Special Program Page<<<] The Genshin Impact HoYoFair Spring Fan Art Special Program will be released soon! Hmm... But something unexpected has happened: The works our participants prepared for the program have been blown away by the wind and drifted into a mysterious space beyond this world... If we fail to retrieve these works in time, HoYoFair may have to be postponed. So, to make sure that HoYoFair is held smoothly, participate in the mini-game to help us retrieve the lost works! As a token of gratitude, we will offer an event-exclusive themed Avatar Frame for every Traveler who completes the event. Travelers will also be assigned an exclusive live stream prize draw ID and can participate in the live stream prize draw to win rewards!
